ITEM 1 | Minced, crumbly mixture of tan-brown granules with darker brown bits and light green flecks, forming a loose mound about 6 cm across and 1.5 cm high in the center of the plate; matte, dry-looking surface with no visible sheen, some scattered loose crumbs around the base; a few thin pale yellow-green shreds and a bright red sliced chili ring sit on top | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubes of pale yellow fruit with slightly translucent edges and a light golden tone, each piece roughly 1.5 to 2 cm square and 1.5 cm tall, with cut faces showing smooth, slightly moist surfaces; about eight pieces clustered in a loose group on the right side of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Thin, pale yellow-green shreds, slightly limp and translucent, forming a small tangle of about 4 cm length over the mound, with one thin strand lying across the crumbled mixture | 3
